thread:
maria: heads up — deploybot failed to promote build 2026.03.21-3345 -> stable. saw a registry tag/digest mismatch during final validation :confused:

maria: log snip: `ERROR: promotion aborted: target tag 'stable' resolved to digest sha256:aaa111 but expected sha256:bbb222 (manifestlist rewrite mismatch)`

jen: hmm, GC run in eu-west around that time? we've seen retag ladder races before when replicas gc older unreferenced manifests.

maria: yep, eu-west GC kicked ~12m before promote. preliminary `skopeo inspect` showed identical image content but different manifestlist ordering -> different digest. cosign/attestations don't match what controller expected.

dan: can deploybot force the promote to the canonical digest instead of tag? @deploybot what fallback do we have?

deploybot: promotion recorded: release/2026-03-21-3345 -> tag stable. Validation failed: digest mismatch. Automatic fallback disabled for this release (manual verification required).

jen: manual path suggestion: avoid mutating stable until we ensure replicas align. create a temp pinned tag (stable-pin-20260321) -> desired digest, then mirror-push canonical blobs to eu-west and re-run validation.

maria: my worry is GC churn: if we repush with different manifestlist the digest might still differ. we should coordinate with registry to pause GC and then mirror the exact blob set (layers + manifestlist) so digest matches.

sre-oncall: I can pause GC in eu-west for 40m. pausing now :white_check_mark:

dan: while GC paused, run `aws ecr batch-get-image --repository prod/apps --image-ids imageDigest=sha256:bbb222 --accepted-media-types application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.list.v2+json` to verify replica state. if it doesn't match, run mirror repair from canary.

maria: running check now, will paste snippets.

maria: eu-west returns a manifestlist but digest is sha256:ccc333 (ordering different). so replica doesn't match canonical. need to repush precise manifest+blobs.

jen: plan: 1) create stable-pin-20260321 -> sha256:aaa111 (pin in control plane) 2) schedule mirror: `registry-mirror repair --from=canary --to=eu-west --digest=sha256:aaa111` 3) after mirror, verify cosign verify against digest and re-run deploybot validation 4) once validated, update stable to canonical digest and remove pin. announce in release notes and leave rollback window 1h.
maria: applied temp pin. release-notes-bot, please draft note.

release-notes-bot: draft: "2026-03-21: stable temporarily pinned to sha256:aaa111 due to manifestlist ordering causing digest mismatch during promotion. Mirror and attestation repair in progress."

maria: kicked off `registry-mirror repair` job. deploybot set to suppressed for this release until manual clear.

deploybot: noted: auto-promotions suppressed for release/2026-03-21 while remediation active.

maria: mirror job completed. eu-west now reports sha256:aaa111. verified `skopeo inspect` and `cosign verify` succeed.

jen: ok proceed to manual promote but keep rollback criteria: revert if canary error rate >4% in first 10m or if latency regression >25% p99.
dan: follow-up: add CI step to canonicalize manifestlist ordering (deterministic ordering of manifests) and add post-publish cross-region digest check failing the CI if drift detected. filing infra#1429.

maria: manual promote executed; stable -> sha256:aaa111. updated release notes and added changelog entry: "Pinned stable temporarily due to manifestlist ordering drift; follow-up: deterministic manifest ordering in CI."

jen: thanks, team. :thumbsup:
